ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a circle, with the center marked O; EF is a horizontal straight line passing through O, which can be regarded as the plane of Earth's revolution orbit. There is also a vertical line passing through O in the figure, which can be understood as the normal direction of EF; PQ is an inclined straight line passing through O, representing Earth's axis. Near O in the figure, the angle between PQ and the vertical normal direction is marked as 20°. Then reason: If EF is the plane of Earth's revolution orbit and PQ is Earth's axis, then the figure shows the angle between Earth's axis and the normal to the orbital plane, that is, the obliquity of the ecliptic becomes 20°. At present the obliquity of the ecliptic is about 23.5°, and at the winter solstice the direct solar point is about at 23.5°S; if the obliquity of the ecliptic is 20°, in winter the direct solar point reaches only as far south as 20°S. Guiyang is located in the low-latitude/subtropical region of the Northern Hemisphere. In winter the direct point is not as far south as at present, the latitudinal distance between Guiyang and the direct point becomes smaller, the winter noon solar altitude becomes larger, and the obtained solar radiation heat increases, so the winter average temperature will rise.
